# 1 Samuel Chapter 5 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 153r | **Source Image:** 1SA_005_page_001.jpg

---

**5:1** And-[the]-Philistines took the-ark of-God, and-they-brought it from-Even-ha-Ezer [Ebenezer] to-Ashdod.

**5:2** And-[the]-Philistines took the-ark of-God, and-they-brought it [into the]-house of-Dagon, and-they-set it beside Dagon.

**5:3** And-rose-early [the]-Ashdodites on-the-next-day, and-behold, Dagon [was]-fallen on-his-face to-the-ground before [the]-ark of-YHWH. And-they-took Dagon and-they-returned him to-his-place.

**5:4** And-they-rose-early in-the-morning on-the-next-day, and-behold, Dagon [was]-fallen on-his-face to-the-ground before [the]-ark of-YHWH, and-[the]-head of-Dagon and-[the]-two palms of-his-hands [were]-cut-off to the-threshold; only [the]-trunk-of-Dagon [dagon, lit. "fish-form"] was-left upon-him.

**5:5** Upon-this the-priests of-Dagon and-all the-ones-coming [into the]-house of-Dagon do-not tread upon [the]-threshold of-Dagon in-Ashdod, until this-day.

**5:6** And-was-heavy [the]-hand of-YHWH upon the-Ashdodites, and-he-devastated them, and-he-struck them [with] tumors [*'ofalim*] -- Ashdod and-its-borders.

**5:7** And-saw [the]-men of-Ashdod that [it was]-so, and-they-said, "Not shall-dwell [the]-ark of-[the]-God of-Israel with-us, for heavy [is]-his-hand upon-us and-upon Dagon our-god."

**5:8** And-they-sent and-they-gathered all [the]-lords of-[the]-Philistines to-them, and-they-said, "What shall-we-do with-[the]-ark of-[the]-God of-Israel?" And-they-said, "To-Gath let-go-around [the]-ark of-[the]-God of-Israel." And-they-brought-around the-ark of-[the]-God of-Israel.

**5:9** And-it-was after they-brought-around it, and-was [the]-hand of-YHWH against-the-city -- a-panic exceedingly great. And-he-struck the-men of-the-city, from-small and-unto great, and-broke-out on-them tumors [*'ofalim*].

**5:10** And-they-sent the-ark of-God [to] Ekron. And-it-was as-[the]-coming of-[the]-ark of-God [to] Ekron, and-cried-out the-Ekronites, saying, "They-have-brought-around to-me the-ark of-[the]-God of-Israel to-kill me and-my-people!"

**5:11** And-they-sent and-they-gathered all [the]-lords of-[the]-Philistines, and-they-said, "Send-away the-ark of-[the]-God of-Israel, and-let-it-return to-its-place, and-not let-it-kill me and-my-people." For there-was a-panic of-death in-all the-city; exceedingly heavy [was the]-hand of-God there.

**5:12** And-the-men who did-not die were-struck with-the-tumors [*'ofalim*], and-went-up [the]-cry of-the-city [to] the-heavens.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **5:4 -- "dagon" (trunk/fish-form):** The MT reads רַק דָּגוֹן נִשְׁאַר עָלָיו, "only Dagon was left upon him." The word דָּגוֹן here may be a play on דָּג (fish), suggesting the fish-shaped lower portion of the idol remained. The Leningrad Codex preserves this reading without variant.

2. **5:6 -- 'ofalim (tumors):** The Ketiv reads עפלים ('ofalim, "tumors/swellings"); the Qere reads טחרים (tehorim, "hemorrhoids"). The Leningrad Codex marks this as a Ketiv-Qere. EMET follows the Ketiv as the written text.

3. **5:6 -- LXX addition:** The LXX (Septuagint) adds a notice about mice devastating the land at this point. The Leningrad Codex (MT) does not contain this addition.

4. **5:9 -- "tumors":** Again Ketiv עפלים / Qere טחרים. Same Ketiv-Qere pattern as 5:6.

5. **5:12 -- "tumors":** Same Ketiv-Qere pattern continues (עפלים / טחרים).

-- EMET
